kn1.title: Agile Sapiens
kn1.subtitle: A literary business analysis: Verne, Shelley, Holmes and Borges diagnosed management long before the consultants arrived.

kn2.title: Consonants Without Vowels
kn2.subtitle: The long war around knowledge: some lock it away, others break the locks — openness wins, again and again.

kn3.title: City of the Sun
kn3.subtitle: Ideal cities — from the heavenly Jerusalem to the Bauhaus — and the question: is it comfortable here for an ordinary person carrying grocery bags?

kn4.title: Where the New Lives
kn4.subtitle: Rules and breakthroughs are not a choice: canon is always late to name the new. Three thousand years of examples from the edges.

kn5.title: By Others' Hands
kn5.subtitle: Between the author and us, someone always stands: the scribe, the censor, the publisher, the editor, the critic — and now the algorithm.

kn6.title: Own Eyes
kn6.subtitle: The world is full of phantoms — and against each one stands someone who went and checked for themselves, and paid the price.

kn7.title: Lost in Conversation
kn7.subtitle: An orchestra plays inside your head — what comes out is a knock. A book about the barriers to understanding and how to break through them.

about.title: About
about.meta_description: About the FolkUp Library: free books under CC BY-SA 4.0, a non-fiction series on teams and people, edited by a human alongside AI, with a human responsible for every word.

section1.h2: What kind of library this is
section1.p1: Here you find books that cannot be locked away.
section1.p2: Each one is published under the free CC BY-SA 4.0 license — read them, download them, share them, translate them, republish them. The only requirement: name the source and pass the freedom on. There is no «full version for a fee»: what you see is the full version.
section1.p3: The series is written in full and released as each book becomes ready — the way books used to be published before the age of deadlines: when the text is ready, not when the calendar demands. Each book passes through an editorial pipeline: sources checked against originals, quotations verified word by word, footnotes kept honest. If we've made a mistake somewhere, write to us — we'll fix it and thank you in the next version. Free books have a luxury unavailable to paper: they can get better after publication.

section2.p1: The books of the series are signed with this name. Who stands behind it does not matter; what matters is that under this name knowledge walks free. Others have done the same: Pessoa handed his letters over to his heteronyms, Banksy left his work on walls without a face. The name is not a mask but a way to move the author's figure off the path the reader is walking.
section2.p2: Behind the texts stands a living person with twenty-five years of practice in software and teams — and an editorial room where a human works alongside artificial intelligence. We do not hide this; we consider it part of the method: the era these books are about has begun in our own editorial room as well. A human is responsible for every word.

section3.p1: We believe that knowledge locked behind a paywall works worse than knowledge that circulates from hand to hand. This idea is set out in the {declarationLink} — the manifesto of our ecosystem. The library is its practical proof: not a call to share, but the act of sharing itself.
section3.p2: The FolkUp ecosystem grows around the library: {articlesLink} on what stayed outside the covers of the books, and {encyclopediasLink} — open collections of knowledge on the series' topics. All under the same free licenses.

section4.p1: With the {firstBookLink} — or with any that catches your eye by its cover. Free books do not need to be read in order: the door is open from any side.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta_description: How we handle data on books.folkup.life. Short answer: we collect nothing personal. Full details on data controller, technical logs, cookies, and your GDPR rights.
content: Who runs this site

This portal is operated by Andrei Klemenchenok, a physical person and resident of Portugal, publishing books under the pseudonym «Команданте FolkUp». This is a non-commercial hobbyist publishing project.

Contact for privacy matters: rights@folkup.app
General editorial contact: editorial@folkup.app
What data we collect
Personally: nothing.

• No user accounts, no registration
  • No forms, no comments, no purchases
  • No newsletter, no tracking pixels
  • No behavioural analytics

Technically: Cloudflare (our infrastructure provider) processes standard HTTP request logs — your IP address, timestamp, requested URL, and user agent. This is required for basic operation and DDoS protection. We do not access, aggregate, or analyse these logs. Cloudflare retains them for approximately 90 days per their standard policy.
Who else sees your data
• Cloudflare, Inc. (CDN, DDoS mitigation, hosting). Cloudflare is GDPR-compliant; their Data Processing Addendum is publicly available at cloudflare.com/cloudflare-customer-dpa.
No data is sold, shared with advertisers, or transferred to any other third party.
Cookies
See our Cookie Policy. Short version: no tracking cookies. Only strictly necessary technical cookies set by Cloudflare for bot management.
Your rights under GDPR
Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Articles 12–22, you have the right to:

• Access any personal data we hold about you
  • Rectification of inaccurate data
  • Erasure («right to be forgotten»)
  • Portability of your data in a machine-readable format
  • Objection to processing
  • Lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority (in Portugal: CNPD)
Since we do not maintain a database of personal data, most of these rights have limited practical effect on this site — but they are yours. Contact rights@folkup.app to exercise them.
No profiling, no automated decisions
We do not profile visitors and do not make automated decisions about you.
Changes
If this policy changes, the «Last updated» date at the top will reflect that. Material changes will be noted on the site's homepage for at least 30 days.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.meta_description: We use no tracking cookies. Only strictly necessary technical cookies from Cloudflare for security. No consent banner because none is required.
content: Short version
This site does not use tracking cookies, analytics cookies, or advertising cookies.

That is why you do not see a cookie consent banner — under the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC (as amended) and Recital 66, consent is not required for cookies that are «strictly necessary» to deliver a service the user requested.
What cookies may be set
The only cookies that may appear in your browser when visiting this site are set by Cloudflare, our infrastructure provider, for security and abuse-prevention purposes:

CookieSet byPurposeDuration
__cf_bmCloudflareBot management — distinguishes humans from automated traffic to protect against abuse30 minutes
cf_clearanceCloudflareRecords that a visitor passed a security challenge (only set if challenge is triggered)30 days
Both are classified as strictly necessary under GDPR / ePrivacy interpretation and Cloudflare's own cookie documentation.
What we do not use

• No Google Analytics, no Matomo, no Plausible, no Fathom
  • No advertising cookies (no Google Ads, no Facebook Pixel, no anything)
  • No social media embedding cookies (we don't embed Facebook, Twitter, etc.)
  • No CDN cookies for third-party fonts or scripts (fonts are self-hosted)
  • No session cookies (we have no accounts)
If we ever add cookieless analytics (such as Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies and does not track individuals), this policy will be updated.
Your control
You can disable or delete cookies through your browser settings. Doing so may affect Cloudflare's ability to distinguish your traffic from automated abuse, but the site will remain functional.
Contact
Questions about cookies? Write to rights@folkup.app.
